goal: Stage, verify, and upload the CGKN 0.2.0-rc.1 review candidate without publishing a stable release or committing runtime outputs.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-commit and committed-checkout governance evidence remain distinguishable and are not promoted into a stable release claim.
Plugin validation, Agent Kit tests, scoped formal-mainline tests, and source compilation are recorded before upload.
Repository, Codex plugin, MCP server, and Agent Kit versions represent one 0.2.0-rc.1 review candidate using ecosystem-correct notation.
The review branch is pushed to origin and resolves to the local commit without creating a Git tag or GitHub Release.
The staged source manifest excludes .cgkn state, workspaces, generated project memory, media, benchmarks, and transient artifacts.

quality_metrics.measure: management artifacts conform to registered JSON schemas and semantic invariants
quality_metrics.target: all management, iteration, and experience artifacts validate
quality_metrics.method: jsonschema tests plus deterministic manager validation

quality_metrics.measure: CGKN uses the same method it exposes
quality_metrics.target: active project pack and iteration exist and repository instructions reference the approved skill

prevention: Confirm acceptance, interfaces, and applicable kernel constraints before implementation.
assurance: Review method, schema, skill, and repository instruction consistency.
Validate that support artifacts cannot authorize formal delivery PASS.
Review changed files against the kernel contract before integration.
control: Run targeted kernel and knowledge tests.
improvement: Record review findings and one bounded improvement experiment.

feedback: The review branch is version-aligned, runtime-clean, remotely verified, and green on the committed checkout; stable tagging remains an explicit later review decision.

worked: Explicit staging kept runtime workspaces, project memory, media, benchmarks, and transient artifacts out of the commit.
Repository, plugin, MCP server, and Agent Kit versions are aligned using ecosystem-correct notation.
Re-running frozen-boundary guards on the committed checkout separated a transient dirty-tree failure from final source evidence.
did_not_work: The first pre-commit guard run could not represent the final committed-checkout state.
experiments: Always rerun repository-state guards after the candidate commit and before the final upload review is closed.
